features.activation_steps: Install onnxruntime (pip install onnxruntime) and download model weights via scripts/download_models.py --download
Set OLLAMA_BASE_URL env var, start Ollama, and run 'ollama pull llama3.1:8b'
Set PMTILES_PATH env var to a .pmtiles file path, or run scripts/offline_prep.sh to generate one via tippecanoe
Run scripts/download_models.py --download to fetch model weights from HuggingFace and upload to MinIO
Set KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS env var to the broker address, or start Redpanda via 'docker compose up redpanda'
Set REDIS_URL env var to the Redis connection URL, or start Redis via 'docker compose up redis'
